question: What is the primary reason for using a professional email address in clinical practice?

options.A: It provides free storage for large clinical document files
options.B: It speeds up internet connection speeds during emergencies
options.C: It automatically encrypts all confidential patient health records
options.D: It establishes professional credibility with colleagues and institutions

explanation: A formal email address shows respect for your profession and ensures you are taken seriously by hospital management and fellow health workers. [learn more](BMP123_U4_T3#BMP123_U4_T3_h1)

question: How should a midwife set up their email display name for official correspondence?

options.A: By using their real name along with their professional title
options.B: By using the brand name of the mobile phone device
options.C: By using a popular nickname known only to close friends
options.D: By keeping it blank to protect personal privacy

explanation: Including your real name and title like Midwife Bello helps recipients immediately identify who is sending the official message. [learn more](BMP123_U4_T3#BMP123_U4_T3_h1)

question: Which email component tells the recipient what the message is about before they open it?
explanation: The subject line gives a quick summary so the reader knows the topic and urgency of the email immediately. [learn more](BMP123_U4_T3#BMP123_U4_T3_h2)

question: What is the best way to write a subject line when sending an urgent clinical shift swap request?

options.B: Urgent Shift Swap Request: Night Duty on Friday - Midwife Zainab
options.C: Important message from the maternity unit

explanation: Clear subject lines contain the exact topic, the specific time or date, and your name so the supervisor can act fast. [learn more](BMP123_U4_T3#BMP123_U4_T3_h2)

question: What does typing an entire email sentence in capital letters usually signify online?

options.A: Making the text easier to read for older supervisors
options.B: Indicating that the email is completely secure
options.C: Highlighting that the message contains financial data
options.D: Shouting or raising your voice at the reader

explanation: In internet communication, writing in all caps is treated as shouting, which can sound aggressive in professional messages. [learn more](BMP123_U4_T3#BMP123_U4_T3_h3)

question: Why should you be careful when using the 'Reply All' button on a large department email thread?

options.A: It can fill up other staff members' inboxes with unnecessary messages
options.B: It prevents the attachment files from opening properly
options.C: It automatically deletes the original message from the server
options.D: It sends the email to people outside the hospital network

explanation: Using reply all when your answer is meant for just one person wastes the time of everyone else copied on the thread. [learn more](BMP123_U4_T3#BMP123_U4_T3_h3)

question: Why is it important to mention an attached file inside the main text of your email?

options.A: To alert the recipient to look for the file even if they miss the icon
options.B: To make the email message pass through anti-virus software faster
options.C: To increase the download speed of the attached document
options.D: To legally force the recipient to print out the document

explanation: Mentioning the attachment in your writing ensures the reader knows a file is included even if the icon is small or hidden on their screen. [learn more](BMP123_U4_T3#BMP123_U4_T3_h4)

question: What is the safest file format to use when sharing official text documents and reports via email?
explanation: PDFs preserve document formatting across different computers and prevent accidental changes to official reports. [learn more](BMP123_U4_T3#BMP123_U4_T3_h4)

question: What type of email account should be avoided when sending sensitive patient information?
explanation: Personal email accounts lack the security measures needed to protect private patient data from unauthorized access. [learn more](BMP123_U4_T3#BMP123_U4_T3_h5)

question: What is the most important action to take after checking your work email on a shared computer in the labour ward?

options.A: Unplug the computer keyboard and mouse
options.B: Shut down the entire computer monitor screen
options.C: Log out of your email account completely
options.D: Delete the internet browser history and cache

explanation: Logging out prevents the next healthcare worker or visitor from opening your private inbox and viewing confidential messages. [learn more](BMP123_U4_T3#BMP123_U4_T3_h5)
